  2392 def check_catalog_route(repo_root: Path) -> None:
  2393     catalog_path = repo_root / "method-catalog.json"
  2394     raw = catalog_path.read_bytes()
  2395     catalog = json.loads(raw)
  2396     require(isinstance(catalog, dict), "method catalog root is not an object")
  2397     require(
  2398         catalog.get("schema") == "pid-rs/method-catalog",
  2399         "method catalog schema changed",
  2400     )
  2401     require(
  2402         catalog.get("schema_revision") == 1, "method catalog schema revision changed"
  2403     )
  2404     canonical = (
  2405         json.dumps(
  2406             catalog,
  2407             ensure_ascii=True,
  2408             indent=2,
  2409             sort_keys=True,
  2410             allow_nan=False,
  2411         )
  2412         + "\n"
  2413     ).encode("utf-8")
  2414     require(raw == canonical, "method catalog is not canonical JSON")
  2415 
  2416     methods = catalog.get("methods")
  2417     references = catalog.get("references")
  2418     require(isinstance(methods, list), "method catalog methods are not a list")
  2419     require(isinstance(references, list), "method catalog references are not a list")
  2420     require(len(methods) == 69, "method catalog no longer contains exactly 69 methods")
  2421     require(
  2422         len(references) == 45, "method catalog no longer contains exactly 45 references"
  2423     )
  2424 
  2425     by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
  2426     for index, method in enumerate(methods):
  2427         require(isinstance(method, dict), f"catalog method {index} is not an object")
  2428         method_id = method.get("id")
  2429         require(
  2430             isinstance(method_id, str) and method_id,
  2431             f"catalog method {index} has no id",
  2432         )
  2433         require(method_id not in by_id, f"duplicate catalog method id: {method_id}")
  2434         by_id[method_id] = method
  2435     require(list(by_id) == sorted(by_id), "method catalog ids are not sorted")
  2436     require(
  2437         set(KSG_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS) <= set(by_id),
  2438         "one or more KSG-affected catalog methods are absent",
  2439     )
  2440     reverse_dependencies: dict[str, set[str]] = {
  2441         method_id: set() for method_id in by_id
  2442     }
  2443     for method_id, method in by_id.items():
  2444         dependencies = method.get("depends_on")
  2445         require(
  2446             isinstance(dependencies, list), f"{method_id}: depends_on is not a list"
  2447         )
  2448         require(
  2449             dependencies == sorted(set(dependencies)),
  2450             f"{method_id}: dependencies are not sorted and unique",
  2451         )
  2452         for dependency in dependencies:
  2453             require(
  2454                 isinstance(dependency, str) and dependency in by_id,
  2455                 f"{method_id}: dependency target is absent: {dependency}",
  2456             )
  2457             reverse_dependencies[dependency].add(method_id)
  2458     reverse_closure = set(KSG_CATALOG_ROOT_METHOD_IDS)
  2459     frontier = list(KSG_CATALOG_ROOT_METHOD_IDS)
  2460     while frontier:
  2461         dependency = frontier.pop()
  2462         for consumer in reverse_dependencies[dependency]:
  2463             if consumer not in reverse_closure:
  2464                 reverse_closure.add(consumer)
  2465                 frontier.append(consumer)
  2466     expected_reverse_closure = set(KSG_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS) | set(
  2467         KSG_CATALOG_REVERSE_CLOSURE_EXCLUSIONS
  2468     )
  2469     require(
  2470         reverse_closure == expected_reverse_closure,
  2471         "KSG reverse-dependency closure changed: "
  2472         f"missing={sorted(expected_reverse_closure - reverse_closure)}, "
  2473         f"unexpected={sorted(reverse_closure - expected_reverse_closure)}",
  2474     )
  2475     require(
  2476         reverse_closure - set(KSG_CATALOG_REVERSE_CLOSURE_EXCLUSIONS)
  2477         == set(KSG_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS),
  2478         "KSG affected catalog inventory is not the declared reverse closure minus the "
  2479         "non-numerical shared-config exclusion",
  2480     )
  2481 
  2482     protected_methods = [
  2483         method for method in methods if method["id"] not in KSG_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS
  2484     ]
  2485     require(len(protected_methods) == 49, "protected catalog method count changed")
  2486     require(
  2487         projection_sha256(protected_methods) == KSG_PROTECTED_CATALOG_METHODS_SHA256,
  2488         "a non-KSG catalog method changed from the KSG milestone parent",
  2489     )
  2490     require(
  2491         projection_sha256(references) == KSG_PROTECTED_CATALOG_REFERENCES_SHA256,
  2492         "catalog references changed during the KSG-only milestone",
  2493     )
  2494     metadata = {
  2495         key: value
  2496         for key, value in catalog.items()
  2497         if key not in ("methods", "references")
  2498     }
  2499     require(
  2500         projection_sha256(metadata) == KSG_PROTECTED_CATALOG_METADATA_SHA256,
  2501         "catalog top-level metadata changed during the KSG-only milestone",
  2502     )
  2503     catalog_text = raw.decode("utf-8")
  2504     for token in KSG_FORBIDDEN_CATALOG_TOKENS:
  2505         require(
  2506             token not in catalog_text,
  2507             f"KSG-only catalog contains later-wave token: {token}",
  2508         )
  2509 
  2510     claim_bound: set[str] = set()
  2511     formal_bound: set[str] = set()
  2512     for method_id, method in by_id.items():
  2513         validation = method.get("validation")
  2514         require(
  2515             isinstance(validation, dict), f"{method_id}: validation block is absent"
  2516         )
  2517         evidence_paths = validation.get("evidence_paths")
  2518         require(
  2519             isinstance(evidence_paths, list),
  2520             f"{method_id}: evidence_paths is not a list",
  2521         )
  2522         require(
  2523             all(isinstance(path, str) and path for path in evidence_paths),
  2524             f"{method_id}: evidence_paths contains a non-string or empty path",
  2525         )
  2526         if method_id in KSG_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS:
  2527             require(
  2528                 evidence_paths == sorted(set(evidence_paths)),
  2529                 f"{method_id}: KSG evidence_paths are not sorted and unique",
  2530             )
  2531         evidence = set(evidence_paths)
  2532         if method_id in KSG_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS:
  2533             for relative in evidence_paths:
  2534                 evidence_path = Path(relative)
  2535                 require(
  2536                     not evidence_path.is_absolute() and ".." not in evidence_path.parts,
  2537                     f"{method_id}: evidence path escapes the repository: {relative}",
  2538                 )
  2539                 require(
  2540                     (repo_root / evidence_path).is_file(),
  2541                     f"{method_id}: bound evidence target is absent: {relative}",
  2542                 )
  2543         if "claims/KSG-INTEGER-HARMONIC-001/claim-v4.md" in evidence:
  2544             claim_bound.add(method_id)
  2545         if evidence & set(KSG_REQUIRED_FORMAL_CATALOG_EVIDENCE):
  2546             formal_bound.add(method_id)
  2547         require(
  2548             "claims/KSG-INTEGER-HARMONIC-001/claim-v1.md" not in evidence
  2549             and "claims/KSG-INTEGER-HARMONIC-001/claim-v2.md" not in evidence
  2550             and "claims/KSG-INTEGER-HARMONIC-001/claim-v3.md" not in evidence,
  2551             f"{method_id}: active catalog evidence cites a stale KSG claim revision",
  2552         )
  2553 
  2554     require(
  2555         claim_bound == set(KSG_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS),
  2556         "KSG claim-bound method inventory changed: "
  2557         f"missing={sorted(set(KSG_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS) - claim_bound)}, "
  2558         f"unexpected={sorted(claim_bound - set(KSG_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS))}",
  2559     )
  2560     require(
  2561         formal_bound == set(KSG_FORMAL_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS),
  2562         "KSG formal-evidence method inventory changed: "
  2563         f"missing={sorted(set(KSG_FORMAL_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS) - formal_bound)}, "
  2564         f"unexpected={sorted(formal_bound - set(KSG_FORMAL_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS))}",
  2565     )
  2566     affected_methods = [
  2567         method for method in methods if method["id"] in KSG_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS
  2568     ]
  2569     require(
  2570         projection_sha256(affected_methods) == KSG_AFFECTED_CATALOG_METHODS_SHA256,
  2571         "reviewed KSG-affected catalog method projection changed",
  2572     )
  2573     for method_id in KSG_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS:
  2574         method = by_id[method_id]
  2575         validation = method["validation"]
  2576         evidence = set(validation["evidence_paths"])
  2577         for path in KSG_REQUIRED_CATALOG_EVIDENCE:
  2578             require(
  2579                 path in evidence,
  2580                 f"{method_id}: required KSG evidence path absent: {path}",
  2581             )
  2582         validation_text = json.dumps(validation, ensure_ascii=True).lower()
  2583         require(
  2584             "integer-harmonic" in validation_text
  2585             or "integer harmonic" in validation_text,
  2586             f"{method_id}: integer-harmonic validation boundary is absent",
  2587         )
  2588     for method_id in KSG_FORMAL_CATALOG_METHOD_IDS:
  2589         evidence = set(by_id[method_id]["validation"]["evidence_paths"])
  2590         for path in KSG_REQUIRED_FORMAL_CATALOG_EVIDENCE:
  2591             require(
  2592                 path in evidence,
  2593                 f"{method_id}: formal KSG evidence path absent: {path}",
  2594             )
  2595 
  2596     shared_config_evidence = set(
  2597         by_id["mutual-information.ksg1-shared-config"]["validation"]["evidence_paths"]
  2598     )
  2599     require(
  2600         not any("KSG-INTEGER-HARMONIC-001" in path for path in shared_config_evidence),
  2601         "unchanged shared KSG config is incorrectly bound to the arithmetic claim",
  2602     )
  2603

  2605 def check_source_route(repo_root: Path) -> None:
  2606     # These guards deliberately remain bounded textual evidence. They reject the named live-code
  2607     # shadow/overwrite attacks after masking comments and strings, but they are not a compiler
  2608     # def-use proof; compiled corpus and tiny count witnesses are the semantic backstop.
  2609     stats_source = (repo_root / "crates/pid-core/src/stats.rs").read_text(
  2610         encoding="utf-8"
  2611     )
  2612     ksg_source = (repo_root / "crates/pid-core/src/ksg.rs").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
  2613     isx_source = (repo_root / "crates/pid-core/src/isx.rs").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
  2614     pid3_source = (repo_root / "crates/pid-core/src/pid3.rs").read_text(
  2615         encoding="utf-8"
  2616     )
  2617     stats = mask_rust_noncode(stats_source)
  2618     ksg = mask_rust_noncode(ksg_source)
  2619     isx = mask_rust_noncode(isx_source)
  2620     pid3 = mask_rust_noncode(pid3_source)
  2621 
  2622     prefix_body = rust_function_body(stats, "shifted_harmonic_table")
  2623     term_body = rust_function_body(stats, "ksg_local_harmonic_term")
  2624     heuristic_body = rust_function_body(isx, "isx_redundancy_heuristic_sketch")
  2625     w1_body = rust_function_body(
  2626         ksg, "ksg_ordered_count_witness_reaches_production_diagnostics"
  2627     )
  2628     w2_body = rust_function_body(
  2629         isx, "ehrlich_inclusive_counts_reach_the_exact_integer_harmonic_local_term"
  2630     )
  2631     w2b_body = rust_function_body(
  2632         isx, "ehrlich_all_unique_rows_attain_the_structural_zero_count_endpoint"
  2633     )
  2634 
  2635     for marker in (
  2636         "pub(crate) fn shifted_harmonic_table(n: usize)",
  2637         "pub(crate) fn ksg_local_harmonic_term(",
  2638         "const KSG_NAIVE_PREFIX_DIRECT_LEFT_NONZEROS: usize = 121;",
  2639         "const KSG_ROUNDED_REFERENCE_OBSERVED_MAX_ERROR_NATS: f64 = 8.0 * f64::EPSILON;",
  2640         "const KSG_ROUNDED_REFERENCE_MAX_ERROR_NATS: f64 = 32.0 * f64::EPSILON;",
  2641         "let mut naive_shifted_harmonics = vec![0.0_f64; max_argument + 1];",
  2642         "naive_prefix_direct_left_nonzeros, KSG_NAIVE_PREFIX_DIRECT_LEFT_NONZEROS,",
  2643     ):
  2644         require(marker in stats, f"shifted-harmonic source marker absent: {marker}")
  2645     for marker in (
  2646         "let len = n.checked_add(1)",
  2647         "for argument in 2..=n",
  2648         "let value = 1.0 / (argument - 1) as f64;",
  2649         "if sum.abs() >= value.abs()",
  2650         "correction += (sum - next) + value;",
  2651         "correction += (value - next) + sum;",
  2652         "out[argument] = sum + correction;",
  2653     ):
  2654         require(
  2655             prefix_body.count(marker) == 1,
  2656             f"shifted-harmonic prefix marker count changed: {marker}",
  2657         )
  2658     require(
  2659         prefix_body.count("out[argument]") == 1,
  2660         "shifted-harmonic prefix output has multiple live reads or writes",
  2661     )
  2662     for marker in (
  2663         "let lower = x.min(y);",
  2664         "let upper = x.max(y);",
  2665         "(shifted_harmonics[n] - shifted_harmonics[upper])",
  2666         "(shifted_harmonics[lower] - shifted_harmonics[k])",
  2667     ):
  2668         require(
  2669             term_body.count(marker) == 1,
  2670             f"source-symmetric range marker count changed: {marker}",
  2671         )
  2672     require(
  2673         term_body.count("let lower =") == 1,
  2674         "lower range binding is shadowed or duplicated",
  2675     )
  2676     require(
  2677         term_body.count("let upper =") == 1,
  2678         "upper range binding is shadowed or duplicated",
  2679     )
  2680 
  2681     require(
  2682         ksg.count("ksg_local_harmonic_term(") == 4, "KSG direct call-site count changed"
  2683     )
  2684     require(
  2685         len(re.findall(r"nx \+ 1,\s*ny \+ 1", ksg)) == 4,
  2686         "KSG exclusive-count off-by-one map changed",
  2687     )
  2688     require(
  2689         "digamma(" not in ksg and "digamma_int_table" not in ksg, "KSG retained digamma"
  2690     )
  2691     require_runtime_estimator_revision(
  2692         mask_rust_comments(ksg_source),
  2693         ksg,
  2694         "ksg_mi_report_with_kernel_and_cancellation",
  2695         "strict-unique-shell-integer-harmonic-report-v4",
  2696     )
  2697     for marker in (
  2698         "let row = diagnostics[5];",
  2699         "assert_eq!(row.joint_radius.to_bits(), 79.0_f64.to_bits());",
  2700         "assert_eq!((row.x_count, row.y_count), (4, 1));",
  2701         "assert_eq!(row.term_nats.to_bits(), 0x3fe0_4e04_e04e_04e0);",
  2702     ):
  2703         require(marker in w1_body, f"W1 production-diagnostic marker absent: {marker}")
  2704     for marker in (
  2705         "(79.0, 5, 2),",
  2706         "local[5].term_nats.to_bits()",
  2707         "0x3fe0_4e04_e04e_04e0",
  2708     ):
  2709         require(marker in w2_body, f"W2 production-diagnostic marker absent: {marker}")
  2710     expected_w2b = """let expected: [(u64, usize, usize, u64); 3] = [
  2711             (1.0_f64.to_bits(), 1, 3, 0_u64),
  2712             (1.0_f64.to_bits(), 1, 3, 0_u64),
  2713             (2.0_f64.to_bits(), 1, 3, 0_u64),
  2714         ];"""
  2715     require(
  2716         w2b_body.count(expected_w2b) == 1,
  2717         "W2b exact three-row radius/count/positive-zero array changed",
  2718     )
  2719     for marker in (
  2720         "assert_eq!(local.len(), expected.len());",
  2721         "local.iter().zip(expected).enumerate()",
  2722         "diagnostic.joint_radius.to_bits()",
  2723         "diagnostic.source_union_count",
  2724         "diagnostic.target_count",
  2725         "diagnostic.term_nats.to_bits()",
  2726     ):
  2727         require(
  2728             marker in w2b_body, f"W2b production-diagnostic marker absent: {marker}"
  2729         )
  2730 
  2731     require(
  2732         isx.count("ksg_local_harmonic_term(") == 1,
  2733         "ISX eligible call-site count changed",
  2734     )
  2735     require(
  2736         "&shifted_harmonics, k, n, n_alpha, n_t" in isx,
  2737         "ISX inclusive index map changed",
  2738     )
  2739     for marker in (
  2740         "let psi_k = digamma(k as f64);",
  2741         "let psi_n = digamma(n as f64);",
  2742         "let psi_int = digamma_int_table(n)?;",
  2743         "let psi_shared = psi_int[n_t_shared[i] + 1];",
  2744         "let psi_s1 = psi_int[n_t_s1[i] + 1];",
  2745         "let psi_s2 = psi_int[n_t_s2[i] + 1];",
  2746         "psi_shared - 0.5 * (psi_s1 + psi_s2)",
  2747         "let redundancy = psi_k + psi_n + avg_term;",
  2748     ):
  2749         require(
  2750             marker in heuristic_body,
  2751             f"non-cancelling heuristic marker absent: {marker}",
  2752         )
  2753     require_runtime_estimator_revision(
  2754         mask_rust_comments(isx_source),
  2755         isx,
  2756         "isx_redundancy_report_with_local_terms",
  2757         "strict-unique-shell-integer-harmonic-isx-v4",
  2758     )
  2759 
  2760     require(
  2761         pid3.count("ksg_local_harmonic_term(") == 1,
  2762         "PID3 eligible call-site count changed",
  2763     )
  2764     require("n_alpha,\n            n_t," in pid3, "PID3 inclusive index map changed")
  2765     require(
  2766         "digamma(" not in pid3 and "digamma_int_table" not in pid3,
  2767         "PID3 retained digamma",
  2768     )
  2769

  2771 def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
  2772     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
  2773     parser.add_argument(
  2774         "--repo-root",
  2775         type=Path,
  2776         default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1],
  2777         help="pid-rs checkout to inspect (defaults to this script's repository)",
  2778     )
  2779     route = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
  2780     route.add_argument(
  2781         "--claim-only",
  2782         action="store_true",
  2783         help=(
  2784             "check only canonical revision-4 claim custody and semantics; this preclosure route "
  2785             "does not imply repository integration GO"
  2786         ),
  2787     )
  2788     route.add_argument(
  2789         "--release-only",
  2790         action="store_true",
  2791         help=(
  2792             "check only the release-family migration; intended for isolated mutation replay, "
  2793             "not as a substitute for the default complete claim checker"
  2794         ),
  2795     )
  2796     route.add_argument(
  2797         "--source-only",
  2798         action="store_true",
  2799         help="check only Rust source correspondence for isolated mutation replay",
  2800     )
  2801     route.add_argument(
  2802         "--exact-only",
  2803         action="store_true",
  2804         help="check only the exact rational identity for isolated mutation replay",
  2805     )
  2806     route.add_argument(
  2807         "--binary64-only",
  2808         action="store_true",
  2809         help="check only the committed binary64 corpus for isolated mutation replay",
  2810     )
  2811     route.add_argument(
  2812         "--enclosure-only",
  2813         action="store_true",
  2814         help="check only the separate exact-rational directed-enclosure route",
  2815     )
  2816     route.add_argument(
  2817         "--catalog-only",
  2818         action="store_true",
  2819         help="check only the exact KSG method-catalog binding for isolated mutation replay",
  2820     )
  2821     return parser.parse_args()
  2822 
  2823 
  2824 def main() -> int:
  2825     args = parse_args()
  2826     try:
  2827         repo_root = args.repo_root.resolve()
  2828         if args.claim_only:
  2829             manifest = check_claim_route(repo_root)
  2830             packet_files = manifest["packet_files"]
  2831             historical_hashes = manifest["historical_hashes"]
  2832             print(
  2833                 "KSG harmonic-revision claim check passed: active revision 4 "
  2834                 f"{manifest['status']}; {len(packet_files)} mapped files; "
  2835                 f"{len(historical_hashes)} historical hashes; "
  2836                 f"stage={manifest['packet_stage']}"
  2837             )
  2838             return 0
  2839         if args.release_only:
  2840             check_release_route(repo_root)
  2841             print(
  2842                 "KSG harmonic-revision release check passed: 15 affected and "
  2843                 "20 protected families"
  2844             )
  2845             return 0
  2846         if args.source_only:
  2847             check_source_route(repo_root)
  2848             print("KSG harmonic-revision source check passed")
  2849             return 0
  2850         if args.exact_only:
  2851             check_exact_route()
  2852             print("KSG harmonic-revision exact check passed: 6,920 tuples")
  2853             return 0
  2854         if args.binary64_only:
  2855             check_binary64_route(load_fixture(repo_root))
  2856             print(
  2857                 "KSG harmonic-revision binary64 check passed: 8,198 Decimal cells; "
  2858                 "binary64-rounded-reference max 8 eps with 40 ties, allowed 32 eps; "
  2859                 "exact-rational error is checked separately; zero source-swap asymmetries"
  2860             )
  2861             return 0
  2862         if args.enclosure_only:
  2863             check_exact_enclosure_route(repo_root)
  2864             print(
  2865                 "KSG harmonic-revision exact-enclosure check passed: "
  2866                 "8,198 directed intervals; 6,920 exact-Fraction containments; "
  2867                 "29-mutation suite is a separate gate"
  2868             )
  2869             return 0
  2870         if args.catalog_only:
  2871             check_catalog_route(repo_root)
  2872             print(

   607 class PhaseIsolationError(RuntimeError):
   608     """A bounded ancestry, tree, custody, or phase-firewall check failed."""
   609 
   610 
   611 @dataclass(frozen=True)
   612 class GitEntry:
   613     mode: str
   614     kind: str
   615     oid: str
   616     sha256: str
   617 
   618 
   619 @dataclass(frozen=True)
   620 class CandidateSnapshot:
   621     entries: dict[str, GitEntry]
   622     head: str
   623     head_entries: dict[str, GitEntry]
   624     tracked_modifications: tuple[str, ...]
   625     untracked: tuple[str, ...]
   626 
   627 
   628 @dataclass(frozen=True)
   629 class FileEvidence:
   630     path: str
   631     mode: int
   632     size: int
   633     mtime_ns: int
   634     sha256: str
   635 
   636 
   637 @dataclass(frozen=True)
   638 class GitBinaryIdentity:
   639     executable: FileEvidence
   640     version: str
   641 
   642 
   643 @dataclass(frozen=True)
   644 class RepositoryContext:
   645     git_binary: GitBinaryIdentity
   646     root: str
   647     git_boundary: FileEvidence
   648     git_dir: str
   649     common_git_dir: str
   650     local_config: FileEvidence
   651     local_config_semantics_sha256: str
   652     info_attributes_absent: bool
   653     worktree_config_absent: bool
   654     replacement_refs_sha256: str
   655

   657 @dataclass(frozen=True)
   658 class PhasePolicyEntry:
   659     path: str
   660     status: str
   661     rationale: str
   662     obligations: tuple[str, ...]
   663 
   664 
   665 def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
   666     if not condition:
   667         raise PhaseIsolationError(message)
   668 
   669 
   670 def stable_external_regular_file(
   671     path: Path, *, label: str
   672 ) -> tuple[FileEvidence, bytes]:
   673     try:
   674         before = path.lstat()
   675     except OSError as error:
   676         raise PhaseIsolationError(f"{label}: cannot inspect {path}: {error}") from error
   677     require(
   678         stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(before.st_mode),
   679         f"{label}: {path} must resolve to a regular non-symlink file",
   680     )
   681     try:
   682         first = path.read_bytes()
   683         middle = path.lstat()
   684         second = path.read_bytes()
   685         after = path.lstat()
   686     except OSError as error:
   687         raise PhaseIsolationError(
   688             f"{label}: cannot read stable bytes: {error}"
   689         ) from error
   690     identity_fields = (
   691         "st_dev",
   692         "st_ino",
   693         "st_mode",
   694         "st_nlink",
   695         "st_size",
   696         "st_mtime_ns",
   697     )
   698     require(
   699         all(getattr(before, name) == getattr(middle, name) for name in identity_fields)
   700         and all(
   701             getattr(middle, name) == getattr(after, name) for name in identity_fields
   702         )
   703         and first == second,
   704         f"{label}: bytes or metadata changed during observation",
   705     )
   706     evidence = FileEvidence(
   707         path=str(path),
   708         mode=stat.S_IMODE(after.st_mode),
   709         size=after.st_size,
   710         mtime_ns=after.st_mtime_ns,
   711         sha256=hashlib.sha256(first).hexdigest(),
   712     )
   713     return evidence, first
   714 
   715 
   716 def resolved_git_executable() -> Path:
   717     global _RESOLVED_GIT_EXECUTABLE
   718     if _RESOLVED_GIT_EXECUTABLE is not None:
   719         return _RESOLVED_GIT_EXECUTABLE
   720     discovered = shutil.which("git")
   721     require(discovered is not None, "cannot locate Git executable")
   722     candidate = Path(discovered)
   723     require(candidate.is_absolute(), "Git executable lookup was not absolute")
   724     try:
   725         resolved = candidate.resolve(strict=True)
   726     except OSError as error:
   727         raise PhaseIsolationError(f"cannot resolve Git executable: {error}") from error
   728     require(resolved.is_absolute(), "resolved Git executable is not absolute")
   729     _RESOLVED_GIT_EXECUTABLE = resolved
   730     return resolved
   731 
   732 
   733 def scrubbed_git_environment() -> dict[str, str]:
   734     environment = dict(os.environ)
   735     for name in tuple(environment):
   736         if name.startswith("GIT_"):
   737             environment.pop(name)
   738     environment.update(
   739         {
   740             "GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM": "1",
   741             "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": os.devnull,
   742             "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM": "1",
   743             "GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM": os.devnull,
   744             "GIT_GRAFT_FILE": os.devnull,
   745             "GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS": "1",
   746             "GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH": "1",
   747             "GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS": "1",
   748             "GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS": "0",
   749             "GIT_PAGER": "cat",
   750             "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT": "0",
   751             "LANG": "C",
   752             "LC_ALL": "C",
   753             "PAGER": "cat",
   754             "TZ": "UTC",
   755         }
   756     )
   757     return environment
   758 
   759 
   760 def git_process(
   761     *arguments: str,
   762     input_bytes: bytes | None = None,
   763     check: bool = True,
   764 ) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
   765     git = resolved_git_executable()
   766     process = subprocess.run(
   767         [
   768             str(git),
   769             "-c",
   770             "core.replaceRefs=false",
   771             "-c",
   772             "advice.detachedHead=false",
   773             "-c",
   774             f"core.attributesFile={os.devnull}",
   775             "-c",
   776             f"core.excludesFile={os.devnull}",
   777             *arguments,
   778         ],
   779         cwd=ROOT,
   780         env=scrubbed_git_environment(),
   781         input=input_bytes,
   782         check=False,
   783         stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
   784         stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
   785     )
   786     if check and process.returncode != 0:
   787         detail = process.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
   788         if not detail:
   789             detail = process.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
   790         raise PhaseIsolationError(
   791             f"git {' '.join(arguments)} failed with {process.returncode}: {detail}"
   792         )
   793     return process
   794 
   795 
   796 def git_text(*arguments: str) -> str:
   797     raw = git_process(*arguments).stdout
   798     try:
   799         return raw.decode("utf-8").strip()
   800     except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
   801         raise PhaseIsolationError(
   802             f"git {' '.join(arguments)} returned non-UTF-8 text"
   803         ) from error
   804 
   805 
   806 def canonical_relative_path(raw: bytes, *, label: str) -> str:
   807     try:
   808         value = raw.decode("utf-8")
   809     except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
   810         raise PhaseIsolationError(f"{label}: non-UTF-8 repository path") from error
   811     path = PurePosixPath(value)
   812     require(
   813         bool(value)
   814         and not path.is_absolute()
   815         and str(path) == value
   816         and "." not in path.parts
   817         and ".." not in path.parts
   818         and "\\" not in value
   819         and "\n" not in value
   820         and "\r" not in value,
   821         f"{label}: non-canonical repository path {value!r}",
   822     )
   823     return value
   824 
   825 
   826 def parse_tree(commit: str) -> dict[str, GitEntry]:
   827     raw = git_process("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--full-tree", commit).stdout
   828     entries: dict[str, GitEntry] = {}
   829     for record in raw.split(b"\0"):
   830         if not record:
   831             continue
   832         try:
   833             metadata, raw_path = record.split(b"\t", 1)
   834             mode_raw, kind_raw, oid_raw = metadata.split(b" ")
   835             mode = mode_raw.decode("ascii")
   836             kind = kind_raw.decode("ascii")
   837             oid = oid_raw.decode("ascii")
   838         except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
   839             raise PhaseIsolationError(
   840                 f"cannot parse canonical Git tree entry at {commit}"
   841             ) from error
   842         path = canonical_relative_path(raw_path, label=f"tree {commit}")
   843         require(path not in entries, f"tree {commit}: duplicate path {path!r}")
   844         require(mode in {"100644", "100755"}, f"tree {commit}: forbidden mode {mode}")
   845         require(kind == "blob", f"tree {commit}: forbidden object type {kind}")
   846         require(bool(HEX40_RE.fullmatch(oid)), f"tree {commit}: invalid object id")
   847         entries[path] = GitEntry(mode=mode, kind=kind, oid=oid, sha256="")
   848     return entries
   849 
   850 
   851 def parse_index() -> dict[str, GitEntry]:
   852     raw = git_process("ls-files", "--stage", "-z").stdout
   853     entries: dict[str, GitEntry] = {}
   854     for record in raw.split(b"\0"):
   855         if not record:
   856             continue
   857         try:
   858             metadata, raw_path = record.split(b"\t", 1)
   859             mode_raw, oid_raw, stage_raw = metadata.split(b" ")
   860             mode = mode_raw.decode("ascii")
   861             oid = oid_raw.decode("ascii")
   862             stage = stage_raw.decode("ascii")
   863         except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
   864             raise PhaseIsolationError(
   865                 "cannot parse canonical Git index entry"
   866             ) from error
   867         path = canonical_relative_path(raw_path, label="Git index")
   868         require(path not in entries, f"Git index: duplicate path {path!r}")
   869         require(stage == "0", f"Git index: nonzero merge stage at {path!r}")
   870         require(mode in {"100644", "100755"}, f"Git index: forbidden mode at {path!r}")
   871         require(bool(HEX40_RE.fullmatch(oid)), "Git index: invalid object id")
   872         entries[path] = GitEntry(mode=mode, kind="blob", oid=oid, sha256="")
   873     return entries
   874 
   875 
   876 def sha256_blobs(object_ids: Iterable[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
   877     ordered = tuple(sorted(set(object_ids)))
   878     if not ordered:
   879         return {}
   880     payload = "".join(f"{oid}\n" for oid in ordered).encode("ascii")
   881     raw = git_process("cat-file", "--batch", input_bytes=payload).stdout
   882     cursor = 0
   883     result: dict[str, str] = {}
   884     for expected_oid in ordered:
   885         newline = raw.find(b"\n", cursor)
   886         require(newline >= 0, "truncated git cat-file batch header")
   887         header = raw[cursor:newline]
   888         cursor = newline + 1
   889         fields = header.split(b" ")
   890         require(len(fields) == 3, "invalid git cat-file batch header")
   891         oid = fields[0].decode("ascii", errors="strict")
   892         kind = fields[1].decode("ascii", errors="strict")
   893         try:
   894             size = int(fields[2].decode("ascii", errors="strict"))
   895         except ValueError as error:
   896             raise PhaseIsolationError("invalid git cat-file object size") from error
   897         require(oid == expected_oid, "git cat-file batch order/object mismatch")
   898         require(kind == "blob" and size >= 0, f"{oid}: expected a nonnegative blob")
   899         end = cursor + size
   900         require(end < len(raw), f"{oid}: truncated git cat-file blob")
   901         blob = raw[cursor:end]
   902         cursor = end
   903         require(raw[cursor : cursor + 1] == b"\n", f"{oid}: missing batch delimiter")
   904         cursor += 1
   905         result[oid] = hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
   906     require(cursor == len(raw), "git cat-file batch returned trailing bytes")
   907     return result
   908 
   909 
   910 def hydrate_tree(entries: dict[str, GitEntry]) -> dict[str, GitEntry]:
   911     hashes = sha256_blobs(entry.oid for entry in entries.values())
   912     return {
   913         path: GitEntry(
   914             mode=entry.mode,
   915             kind=entry.kind,
   916             oid=entry.oid,
   917             sha256=hashes[entry.oid],
   918         )
   919         for path, entry in entries.items()
   920     }
   921 
   922 
   923 def stable_regular_file(relative: str) -> tuple[str, bytes]:
   924     candidate = ROOT / relative
   925     current = ROOT
   926     for component in PurePosixPath(relative).parts[:-1]:
   927         current = current / component
   928         try:
   929             metadata = current.lstat()
   930         except OSError as error:
   931             raise PhaseIsolationError(
   932                 f"{relative!r}: cannot inspect parent directory: {error}"
   933             ) from error
   934         require(
   935             stat.S_ISDIR(metadata.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(metadata.st_mode),
   936             f"{relative!r}: parent path is not a real directory",
   937         )
   938     try:
   939         before = candidate.lstat()
   940     except OSError as error:
   941         raise PhaseIsolationError(
   942             f"{relative!r}: candidate path is missing: {error}"
   943         ) from error
   944     require(
   945         stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(before.st_mode),
   946         f"{relative!r}: candidate must be a regular non-symlink file",
   947     )
   948     require(
   949         before.st_nlink == 1, f"{relative!r}: hard-linked candidate file is forbidden"
   950     )
   951     permissions = stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode)
   952     require(
   953         permissions in {0o644, 0o755},
   954         f"{relative!r}: non-canonical permissions {permissions:#o}",
   955     )
   956     try:
   957         first = candidate.read_bytes()
   958         middle = candidate.lstat()
   959         second = candidate.read_bytes()
   960         after = candidate.lstat()
   961     except OSError as error:
   962         raise PhaseIsolationError(
   963             f"{relative!r}: cannot read stable bytes: {error}"
   964         ) from error
   965     identity_fields = (
   966         "st_dev",
   967         "st_ino",
   968         "st_mode",
   969         "st_nlink",
   970         "st_size",
   971         "st_mtime_ns",
   972     )
   973     require(
   974         all(getattr(before, name) == getattr(middle, name) for name in identity_fields)
   975         and all(
   976             getattr(middle, name) == getattr(after, name) for name in identity_fields
   977         )
   978         and first == second,
   979         f"{relative!r}: candidate bytes changed during observation",
   980     )
   981     mode = "100755" if permissions == 0o755 else "100644"
   982     return mode, first
   983 
   984 
   985 def git_blob_oid(raw: bytes) -> str:
   986     header = f"blob {len(raw)}\0".encode("ascii")
   987     return hashlib.sha1(header + raw).hexdigest()
   988 
   989 
   990 def parse_untracked() -> tuple[str, ...]:
   991     # Deliberately do not use --exclude-standard: workstation-local info/exclude bytes are not
   992     # portable to a fresh clone and therefore cannot be a semantic candidate-enumeration input.
   993     # The only ignore grammar is the exact tracked and protected root .gitignore.
   994     raw = git_process(
   995         "ls-files",
   996         "--others",
   997         "--exclude-from=.gitignore",
   998         "-z",
   999     ).stdout
  1000     paths = [
  1001         canonical_relative_path(item, label="untracked candidate")
  1002         for item in raw.split(b"\0")
  1003         if item
  1004     ]
  1005     require(paths == sorted(paths), "Git returned non-canonical untracked path order")
  1006     require(len(paths) == len(set(paths)), "Git returned duplicate untracked paths")
  1007     return tuple(paths)
  1008 
  1009 
  1010 def collect_candidate_snapshot() -> CandidateSnapshot:
  1011     head = git_text("rev-parse", "HEAD^{commit}")
  1012     require(bool(HEX40_RE.fullmatch(head)), "HEAD did not resolve to an exact commit")
  1013     head_entries = parse_tree(head)
  1014     index_entries = parse_index()
  1015     require(
  1016         {
  1017             path: (entry.mode, entry.kind, entry.oid)
  1018             for path, entry in index_entries.items()
  1019         }
  1020         == {
  1021             path: (entry.mode, entry.kind, entry.oid)
  1022             for path, entry in head_entries.items()
  1023         },
  1024         "Git index differs from HEAD; phase input requires an unstaged index",
  1025     )
  1026     untracked = parse_untracked()
  1027     require(
  1028         not set(untracked).intersection(index_entries),
  1029         "candidate path is both tracked and untracked",
  1030     )
  1031 
  1032     entries: dict[str, GitEntry] = {}
  1033     tracked_modifications: list[str] = []
  1034     for path in sorted((*index_entries.keys(), *untracked)):
  1035         mode, raw = stable_regular_file(path)
  1036         entry = GitEntry(
  1037             mode=mode,
  1038             kind="blob",
  1039             oid=git_blob_oid(raw),
  1040             sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
  1041         )
  1042         entries[path] = entry
  1043         head_entry = head_entries.get(path)
  1044         if head_entry is not None and (
  1045             mode != head_entry.mode or entry.oid != head_entry.oid
  1046         ):
  1047             tracked_modifications.append(path)
  1048     return CandidateSnapshot(
  1049         entries=entries,
  1050         head=head,
  1051         head_entries=head_entries,
  1052         tracked_modifications=tuple(tracked_modifications),
  1053         untracked=untracked,
  1054     )
  1055 
  1056 
  1057 def changed_paths(
  1058     baseline: dict[str, GitEntry], candidate: dict[str, GitEntry]
  1059 ) -> tuple[str, ...]:
  1060     result: list[str] = []
  1061     for path in sorted(set(baseline).union(candidate)):
  1062         left = baseline.get(path)
  1063         right = candidate.get(path)
  1064         if (
  1065             left is None
  1066             or right is None
  1067             or (left.mode, left.kind, left.sha256)
  1068             != (right.mode, right.kind, right.sha256)
  1069         ):
  1070             result.append(path)
  1071     return tuple(result)
  1072 
  1073 
  1074 def classified_delta(
  1075     base: dict[str, GitEntry], candidate: dict[str, GitEntry]
  1076 ) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
  1077     result: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
  1078     for path in changed_paths(base, candidate):
  1079         left = base.get(path)
  1080         right = candidate.get(path)
  1081         status = "A" if left is None else "D" if right is None else "M"
  1082         result.append((path, status))
  1083     return tuple(result)
  1084 
  1085 
  1086 def changed_projection(
  1087     baseline: dict[str, GitEntry],
  1088     candidate: dict[str, GitEntry],
  1089     paths: Iterable[str],
  1090 ) -> str:
  1091     digest = hashlib.sha256()
  1092     for path in sorted(set(paths).difference(SELF_UNHASHED_PATHS)):
  1093         left = baseline.get(path)
  1094         right = candidate.get(path)
  1095         status = "A" if left is None else "D" if right is None else "M"
  1096         if right is None:
  1097             line = f"{status}\0{path}\0-\0-\n"
  1098         else:
  1099             line = f"{status}\0{path}\0{right.mode}\0{right.sha256}\n"
  1100         digest.update(line.encode("utf-8"))
  1101     return digest.hexdigest()
  1102 
  1103 
  1104 def path_projection(entries: dict[str, GitEntry], paths: Iterable[str]) -> str:
  1105     digest = hashlib.sha256()
  1106     for path in sorted(paths):
  1107         entry = entries[path]
  1108         digest.update(
  1109             f"{path}\0{entry.mode}\0{entry.kind}\0{entry.sha256}\n".encode("utf-8")
  1110         )
  1111     return digest.hexdigest()
  1112 
  1113 
  1114 def allowlist_digest(paths: Iterable[str]) -> str:
  1115     ordered = tuple(paths)
  1116     payload = "".join(f"{path}\n" for path in ordered).encode("utf-8")
  1117     return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
  1118 
  1119 
  1120 def commit_identity(commit: str) -> tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]:
  1121     raw = git_process("cat-file", "-p", commit).stdout
  1122     try:
  1123         header = raw.split(b"\n\n", 1)[0].decode("ascii")
  1124     except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
  1125         raise PhaseIsolationError(f"{commit}: non-ASCII commit header") from error
  1126     tree_values = [line[5:] for line in header.splitlines() if line.startswith("tree ")]
  1127     parent_values = [
  1128         line[7:] for line in header.splitlines() if line.startswith("parent ")
  1129     ]
  1130     require(
  1131         len(tree_values) == 1 and bool(HEX40_RE.fullmatch(tree_values[0])),
  1132         f"{commit}: invalid tree header",
  1133     )
  1134     require(
  1135         all(bool(HEX40_RE.fullmatch(parent)) for parent in parent_values),
  1136         f"{commit}: invalid parent header",
  1137     )
  1138     return tree_values[0], tuple(parent_values)
  1139 
  1140 
  1141 def is_ancestor(ancestor: str, descendant: str) -> bool:
  1142     process = git_process(
  1143         "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", ancestor, descendant, check=False
  1144     )
  1145     if process.returncode == 0:
  1146         return True
  1147     if process.returncode == 1:
  1148         return False
  1149     detail = process.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
  1150     raise PhaseIsolationError(
  1151         f"cannot resolve ancestry {ancestor}..{descendant}: {detail}"
  1152     )
  1153 
  1154 
  1155 def git_boundary_evidence(path: Path) -> FileEvidence:
  1156     try:
  1157         before = path.lstat()
  1158     except OSError as error:
  1159         raise PhaseIsolationError(f"cannot inspect .git boundary: {error}") from error
  1160     require(not stat.S_ISLNK(before.st_mode), "symlinked .git boundary is forbidden")
  1161     if stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode):
  1162         require(before.st_nlink == 1, "hard-linked .git file is forbidden")
  1163         evidence, _raw = stable_external_regular_file(path, label=".git boundary")
  1164         return evidence
  1165     require(stat.S_ISDIR(before.st_mode), ".git must be a file or directory")
  1166     try:
  1167         after = path.lstat()
  1168     except OSError as error:
  1169         raise PhaseIsolationError(f"cannot replay .git boundary: {error}") from error
  1170     fields = ("st_dev", "st_ino", "st_mode", "st_nlink", "st_size", "st_mtime_ns")
  1171     require(
  1172         all(getattr(before, name) == getattr(after, name) for name in fields),
  1173         ".git directory metadata changed during observation",
  1174     )
  1175     descriptor = (
  1176         f"directory\0{before.st_dev}\0{before.st_ino}\0"
  1177         f"{before.st_mode}\0{before.st_nlink}\0{before.st_size}\0"
  1178         f"{before.st_mtime_ns}\n"
  1179     ).encode("ascii")
  1180     return FileEvidence(
  1181         path=str(path),
  1182         mode=stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode),
  1183         size=before.st_size,
  1184         mtime_ns=before.st_mtime_ns,
  1185         sha256=hashlib.sha256(descriptor).hexdigest(),
  1186     )
  1187 
  1188 
  1189 def parse_local_config(raw: bytes) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
  1190     result: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
  1191     for record in raw.split(b"\0"):
  1192         if not record:
  1193             continue
  1194         try:
  1195             raw_key, raw_value = record.split(b"\n", 1)
  1196             key = raw_key.decode("utf-8").lower()
  1197             value = raw_value.decode("utf-8")
  1198         except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
  1199             raise PhaseIsolationError(
  1200                 "cannot parse isolated local Git configuration"
  1201             ) from error
  1202         require(key and "\n" not in key and "\0" not in value, "invalid local Git key")
  1203         result.append((key, value))
  1204     for key, _value in result:
  1205         require(
  1206             key not in FORBIDDEN_LOCAL_CONFIG_KEYS
  1207             and not any(
  1208                 key.startswith(prefix) for prefix in FORBIDDEN_LOCAL_CONFIG_PREFIXES
  1209             ),
  1210             f"forbidden local Git configuration key: {key}",
  1211         )
  1212     return tuple(result)
  1213 
  1214 
  1215 def validate_absent_git_path(path: Path, *, label: str) -> None:
  1216     require(
  1217         not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink(),
  1218         f"Git overlay file is forbidden: {label}",
  1219     )
  1220 
  1221 
  1222 def validate_repository_context() -> RepositoryContext:
  1223     require(not SCRIPT_PATH.is_symlink(), "phase checker itself must not be a symlink")
  1224     git = resolved_git_executable()
  1225     git_evidence, _git_raw = stable_external_regular_file(
  1226         git, label="resolved Git executable"
  1227     )
  1228     require(
  1229         bool(HEX64_RE.fullmatch(git_evidence.sha256)),
  1230         "resolved Git executable digest is not canonical SHA-256",
  1231     )
  1232     version_raw = git_process("--version").stdout
  1233     try:
  1234         version = version_raw.decode("utf-8").strip()
  1235     except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
  1236         raise PhaseIsolationError("Git version output is not UTF-8") from error
  1237     require(
  1238         version.startswith("git version ") and "\n" not in version,
  1239         "Git version output has an unexpected shape",
  1240     )
  1241     git_identity = GitBinaryIdentity(executable=git_evidence, version=version)
  1242 
  1243     try:
  1244         expected_root = ROOT.resolve(strict=True)
  1245         reported_root = Path(git_text("rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")).resolve(
  1246             strict=True
  1247         )
  1248     except OSError as error:
  1249         raise PhaseIsolationError(
  1250             f"cannot resolve canonical repository root: {error}"
  1251         ) from error
  1252     require(
  1253         reported_root == expected_root, "Git worktree root does not match checker root"
  1254     )
  1255     require(
  1256         git_text("rev-parse", "--show-object-format=storage") == "sha1",
  1257         "phase checker is pinned to this repository's SHA-1 Git object format",
  1258     )
  1259     require(
  1260         git_text("rev-parse", "--is-shallow-repository") == "false",
  1261         "shallow repositories are outside the ancestry claim",
  1262     )
  1263 
  1264     dot_git = ROOT / ".git"
  1265     boundary_evidence = git_boundary_evidence(dot_git)
  1266 
  1267     git_dir = Path(git_text("rev-parse", "--git-dir"))
  1268     if not git_dir.is_absolute():
  1269         git_dir = ROOT / git_dir
  1270     common_git_dir = Path(git_text("rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"))
  1271     if not common_git_dir.is_absolute():
  1272         common_git_dir = ROOT / common_git_dir
  1273     try:
  1274         resolved_git_dir = git_dir.resolve(strict=True)
  1275         resolved_common_git_dir = common_git_dir.resolve(strict=True)
  1276     except OSError as error:
  1277         raise PhaseIsolationError(
  1278             f"cannot resolve Git metadata directories: {error}"
  1279         ) from error
  1280     require(
  1281         resolved_git_dir.is_dir() and resolved_common_git_dir.is_dir(),
  1282         "Git metadata roots must resolve to directories",
  1283     )
  1284 
  1285     for relative in ("info/grafts", "objects/info/alternates"):
  1286         validate_absent_git_path(
  1287             resolved_common_git_dir / relative,
  1288             label=relative,
  1289         )
  1290     validate_absent_git_path(
  1291         resolved_common_git_dir / "info/attributes",
  1292         label="info/attributes",
  1293     )
  1294     validate_absent_git_path(
  1295         resolved_git_dir / "config.worktree",
  1296         label="config.worktree",
  1297     )
  1298 
  1299     local_config, _local_config_raw = stable_external_regular_file(
  1300         resolved_common_git_dir / "config",
  1301         label="local Git configuration",
  1302     )
  1303     config_process = git_process(
  1304         "config",
  1305         "--no-includes",
  1306         "--local",
  1307         "--null",
  1308         "--list",
  1309     )
  1310     config_semantics = parse_local_config(config_process.stdout)
  1311     config_semantics_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(
  1312         json.dumps(
  1313             config_semantics,
  1314             separators=(",", ":"),
  1315             ensure_ascii=True,
  1316         ).encode("ascii")
  1317     ).hexdigest()
  1318 
  1319     replacement_refs = git_process(
  1320         "for-each-ref",
  1321         "--format=%(refname)",
  1322         "refs/replace",
  1323     ).stdout
  1324     require(
  1325         not replacement_refs,
  1326         "Git replacement references are forbidden",
  1327     )
  1328     return RepositoryContext(
  1329         git_binary=git_identity,
  1330         root=str(expected_root),
  1331         git_boundary=boundary_evidence,
  1332         git_dir=str(resolved_git_dir),
  1333         common_git_dir=str(resolved_common_git_dir),
  1334         local_config=local_config,
  1335         local_config_semantics_sha256=config_semantics_sha256,
  1336         info_attributes_absent=True,
  1337         worktree_config_absent=True,
  1338         replacement_refs_sha256=hashlib.sha256(replacement_refs).hexdigest(),
  1339     )
  1340

  1342 def validate_commit_envelope(head: str) -> None:
  1343     baseline_tree, _baseline_parents = commit_identity(SCIENTIFIC_BASELINE)
  1344     require(
  1345         baseline_tree == SCIENTIFIC_BASELINE_TREE,
  1346         "scientific baseline tree pin mismatch",
  1347     )
  1348     delivery_tree, delivery_parents = commit_identity(DELIVERY_PARENT)
  1349     require(
  1350         delivery_tree == DELIVERY_PARENT_TREE,
  1351         "delivery parent tree pin mismatch",
  1352     )
  1353     require(
  1354         delivery_parents == (SCIENTIFIC_BASELINE,),
  1355         "delivery commit is not the exact direct child of the scientific baseline",
  1356     )
  1357     for commit, expected_parent, expected_tree in DECLARED_COMMIT_CHAIN:
  1358         tree, parents = commit_identity(commit)
  1359         require(tree == expected_tree, f"{commit}: declared tree pin mismatch")
  1360         require(
  1361             parents == (expected_parent,),
  1362             f"{commit}: declared single-parent pin mismatch",
  1363         )
  1364     require(
  1365         is_ancestor(CURRENT_ANCHOR, head),
  1366         "HEAD does not descend from the exact current KSG anchor",
  1367     )
  1368 
  1369     previous = CURRENT_ANCHOR
  1370     later_raw = git_text(
  1371         "rev-list", "--first-parent", "--reverse", f"{CURRENT_ANCHOR}..{head}"
  1372     )
  1373     later = tuple(later_raw.splitlines()) if later_raw else ()
  1374     for commit in later:
  1375         require(bool(HEX40_RE.fullmatch(commit)), "invalid post-anchor commit id")
  1376         _tree, parents = commit_identity(commit)
  1377         require(
  1378             parents == (previous,),
  1379             f"{commit}: post-anchor history must be a single-parent fast-forward",
  1380         )
  1381         previous = commit
  1382

  1384 def parse_name_status(raw: bytes, *, label: str) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
  1385     fields = raw.split(b"\0")
  1386     if fields and not fields[-1]:
  1387         fields.pop()
  1388     require(len(fields) % 2 == 0, f"{label}: malformed Git name-status stream")
  1389     result: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
  1390     for index in range(0, len(fields), 2):
  1391         try:
  1392             status_value = fields[index].decode("ascii")
  1393         except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
  1394             raise PhaseIsolationError(f"{label}: non-ASCII Git status") from error
  1395         require(
  1396             status_value in {"A", "M", "D"},
  1397             f"{label}: forbidden Git delta status {status_value!r}",
  1398         )
  1399         path = canonical_relative_path(fields[index + 1], label=label)
  1400         result.append((path, status_value))
  1401     require(
  1402         tuple(path for path, _status in result)
  1403         == tuple(sorted(path for path, _status in result)),
  1404         f"{label}: Git delta paths are not canonical and sorted",
  1405     )
  1406     require(
  1407         len(result) == len({path for path, _status in result}),
  1408         f"{label}: duplicate Git delta path",
  1409     )
  1410     return tuple(result)
  1411 
  1412 
  1413 def post_anchor_history(
  1414     head: str,
  1415 ) -> tuple[
  1416     tuple[str, tuple[tuple[str, str], ...], dict[str, GitEntry]],
  1417     ...,
  1418 ]:
  1419     commits_raw = git_text(
  1420         "rev-list",
  1421         "--first-parent",
  1422         "--reverse",
  1423         f"{CURRENT_ANCHOR}..{head}",
  1424     )
  1425     commits = tuple(commits_raw.splitlines()) if commits_raw else ()
  1426     require(
  1427         len(commits) <= MAX_POST_ANCHOR_COMMITS,
  1428         "post-anchor history exceeds the bounded commit count",
  1429     )
  1430     previous = CURRENT_ANCHOR
  1431     result: list[tuple[str, tuple[tuple[str, str], ...], dict[str, GitEntry]]] = []
  1432     for commit in commits:
  1433         raw = git_process(
  1434             "diff-tree",
  1435             "--no-commit-id",
  1436             "--name-status",
  1437             "--no-renames",
  1438             "-r",
  1439             "-z",
  1440             previous,
  1441             commit,
  1442         ).stdout
  1443         result.append(
  1444             (
  1445                 commit,
  1446                 parse_name_status(raw, label=f"post-anchor commit {commit}"),
  1447                 hydrate_tree(parse_tree(commit)),
  1448             )
  1449         )
  1450         previous = commit
  1451     return tuple(result)
  1452

  1454 def validate_phase_path_policy(
  1455     snapshot: CandidateSnapshot,
  1456     anchor: dict[str, GitEntry],
  1457 ) -> tuple[PhasePolicyEntry, ...]:
  1458     raw = read_candidate_bytes(PHASE_PATH_POLICY)
  1459     require(
  1460         hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == PHASE_PATH_POLICY_SHA256,
  1461         "phase path policy digest differs from the manually reviewed authority",
  1462     )
  1463     policy = canonical_json_from_bytes(raw, label=PHASE_PATH_POLICY)
  1464     require(isinstance(policy, dict), "phase path policy root must be an object")
  1465     require(
  1466         set(policy)
  1467         == {
  1468             "anchor",
  1469             "authority",
  1470             "deletions_permitted",
  1471             "entries",
  1472             "review_classes",
  1473             "schema",
  1474             "schema_revision",
  1475         },
  1476         "phase path policy has an unexpected top-level shape",
  1477     )
  1478     require(
  1479         policy.get("schema") == "pid-rs/ksg-phase-path-policy"
  1480         and policy.get("schema_revision") == 1,
  1481         "phase path policy schema identity is invalid",
  1482     )
  1483     require(
  1484         policy.get("anchor")
  1485         == {
  1486             "commit": CURRENT_ANCHOR,
  1487             "tree": CURRENT_ANCHOR_TREE,
  1488         },
  1489         "phase path policy is not bound to the exact current anchor",
  1490     )
  1491     require(
  1492         policy.get("deletions_permitted") is False,
  1493         "phase path policy must forbid every deletion",
  1494     )
  1495     require(
  1496         policy.get("authority")
  1497         == {
  1498             "authoritative": True,
  1499             "mechanical_resealing_permitted": False,
  1500             "scope": "KSG revision-4 integration delta only",
  1501         },
  1502         "phase path policy authority contract changed",
  1503     )
  1504     raw_entries = policy.get("entries")
  1505     raw_classes = policy.get("review_classes")
  1506     require(
  1507         isinstance(raw_entries, list) and raw_entries,
  1508         "phase path policy entries must be a nonempty array",
  1509     )
  1510     require(
  1511         isinstance(raw_classes, dict) and raw_classes,
  1512         "phase path policy review classes must be a nonempty object",
  1513     )
  1514     review_classes: dict[str, tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]] = {}
  1515     for class_name, class_value in raw_classes.items():
  1516         require(
  1517             isinstance(class_name, str)
  1518             and class_name
  1519             and isinstance(class_value, dict)
  1520             and set(class_value) == {"obligations", "rationale"},
  1521             f"phase path policy review class {class_name!r} has an unexpected shape",
  1522         )
  1523         rationale = class_value.get("rationale")
  1524         obligations = class_value.get("obligations")
  1525         require(
  1526             isinstance(rationale, str)
  1527             and len(rationale.strip()) >= 12
  1528             and "\n" not in rationale,
  1529             f"phase path policy review class {class_name!r} lacks a rationale",
  1530         )
  1531         require(
  1532             isinstance(obligations, list)
  1533             and obligations
  1534             and all(
  1535                 isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() and "\n" not in item
  1536                 for item in obligations
  1537             )
  1538             and len(obligations) == len(set(obligations)),
  1539             f"phase path policy review class {class_name!r} has invalid obligations",
  1540         )
  1541         review_classes[class_name] = (rationale, tuple(obligations))
  1542     entries: list[PhasePolicyEntry] = []
  1543     for index, value in enumerate(raw_entries):
  1544         require(
  1545             isinstance(value, dict)
  1546             and set(value) == {"path", "review_class", "status"},
  1547             f"phase path policy entry {index} has an unexpected shape",
  1548         )
  1549         raw_path = value.get("path")
  1550         require(
  1551             isinstance(raw_path, str),
  1552             f"phase path policy entry {index} has a non-string path",
  1553         )
  1554         path = canonical_relative_path(
  1555             raw_path.encode("utf-8"),
  1556             label=f"phase path policy entry {index}",
  1557         )
  1558         status_value = value.get("status")
  1559         review_class = value.get("review_class")
  1560         require(
  1561             status_value in {"A", "M"},
  1562             f"phase path policy entry {path!r} is not classified A or M",
  1563         )
  1564         require(
  1565             isinstance(review_class, str) and review_class in review_classes,
  1566             f"phase path policy entry {path!r} references an unknown review class",
  1567         )
  1568         rationale, obligations = review_classes[review_class]
  1569         entries.append(
  1570             PhasePolicyEntry(
  1571                 path=path,
  1572                 status=status_value,
  1573                 rationale=rationale,
  1574                 obligations=obligations,
  1575             )
  1576         )
  1577     require(
  1578         tuple(entry.path for entry in entries)
  1579         == tuple(sorted(entry.path for entry in entries))
  1580         and len(entries) == len({entry.path for entry in entries}),
  1581         "phase path policy entries are not sorted and duplicate-free",
  1582     )
  1583     policy_delta = tuple((entry.path, entry.status) for entry in entries)
  1584     actual_delta = classified_delta(anchor, snapshot.entries)
  1585     require(
  1586         all(status_value != "D" for _path, status_value in actual_delta),
  1587         "candidate delta from current anchor contains a forbidden deletion",
  1588     )
  1589     require(
  1590         actual_delta == policy_delta,
  1591         "candidate anchor delta differs from the separately reviewed A/M path policy",
  1592     )
  1593     require(
  1594         (PHASE_PATH_POLICY, "A") in policy_delta,
  1595         "phase path policy must classify its own new path as added",
  1596     )
  1597 
  1598     policy_by_path = {entry.path: entry.status for entry in entries}
  1599     expected_tree = dict(anchor)
  1600     transitioned: set[str] = set()
  1601     for commit, changes, commit_tree in post_anchor_history(snapshot.head):
  1602         for path, status_value in changes:
  1603             require(
  1604                 status_value != "D",
  1605                 f"{commit}: post-anchor history contains forbidden deletion of {path}",
  1606             )
  1607             require(
  1608                 path in policy_by_path,
  1609                 f"{commit}: post-anchor history touched non-policy path {path}",
  1610             )
  1611             require(
  1612                 path not in transitioned,
  1613                 f"{commit}: policy path changed after its exact final transition: {path}",
  1614             )
  1615             expected_status = policy_by_path[path]
  1616             require(
  1617                 status_value == expected_status,
  1618                 (
  1619                     f"{commit}: policy path {path} has invalid {status_value} "
  1620                     f"transition; expected one exact {expected_status}"
  1621                 ),
  1622             )
  1623             final_entry = snapshot.entries.get(path)
  1624             require(
  1625                 final_entry is not None,
  1626                 f"{commit}: final reviewed candidate path is absent: {path}",
  1627             )
  1628             expected_tree[path] = final_entry
  1629             transitioned.add(path)
  1630         require(
  1631             commit_tree == expected_tree,
  1632             (
  1633                 f"{commit}: post-anchor tree is not a monotone composition of "
  1634                 "exact anchor/absent and exact final reviewed path states"
  1635             ),
  1636         )
  1637     if snapshot.head != CURRENT_ANCHOR:
  1638         require(
  1639             transitioned == set(policy_by_path),
  1640             "committed-descendant history did not transition every policy path exactly once",
  1641         )
  1642     return tuple(entries)
  1643

  1645 def validate_staged_tree_custody(
  1646     snapshot: CandidateSnapshot,
  1647     expected_tree: str | None,
  1648     checkpoint_commit: str | None,
  1649 ) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
  1650     require(
  1651         expected_tree is not None or checkpoint_commit is None,
  1652         "--checkpoint-commit requires --expected-candidate-tree",
  1653     )
  1654     if expected_tree is None:
  1655         return None, None
  1656     require(
  1657         bool(HEX40_RE.fullmatch(expected_tree)),
  1658         "expected candidate tree is not a canonical SHA-1 object id",
  1659     )
  1660     resolved_tree = git_text("rev-parse", f"{expected_tree}^{{tree}}")
  1661     require(
  1662         resolved_tree == expected_tree,
  1663         "expected candidate tree does not resolve to the exact supplied tree id",
  1664     )
  1665     staged_entries = hydrate_tree(parse_tree(expected_tree))
  1666     require(
  1667         staged_entries == snapshot.entries,
  1668         "external staged/checkpoint tree differs from the candidate snapshot",
  1669     )
  1670     if checkpoint_commit is not None:
  1671         require(
  1672             bool(HEX40_RE.fullmatch(checkpoint_commit)),
  1673             "checkpoint commit is not a canonical SHA-1 object id",
  1674         )
  1675         commit_tree, parents = commit_identity(checkpoint_commit)
  1676         require(
  1677             commit_tree == expected_tree,
  1678             "checkpoint commit tree differs from the externally supplied tree",
  1679         )
  1680         if checkpoint_commit != snapshot.head:
  1681             require(
  1682                 parents == (snapshot.head,),
  1683                 "detached checkpoint commit is not the exact child of snapshot HEAD",
  1684             )
  1685     return expected_tree, checkpoint_commit
  1686

  1688 def canonical_json_from_bytes(raw: bytes, *, label: str) -> Any:
  1689     def reject_duplicate_keys(pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
  1690         result: dict[str, Any] = {}
  1691         for key, value in pairs:
  1692             if key in result:
  1693                 raise PhaseIsolationError(f"{label}: duplicate JSON key {key!r}")
  1694             result[key] = value
  1695         return result
  1696 
  1697     def reject_nonfinite(token: str) -> None:
  1698         raise PhaseIsolationError(f"{label}: non-finite JSON token {token!r}")
  1699 
  1700     try:
  1701         text = raw.decode("utf-8")
  1702         value = json.loads(
  1703             text,
  1704             object_pairs_hook=reject_duplicate_keys,
  1705             parse_constant=reject_nonfinite,
  1706         )
  1707     except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
  1708         raise PhaseIsolationError(
  1709             f"{label}: invalid canonical JSON: {error}"
  1710         ) from error
  1711     rendered = json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True) + "\n"
  1712     require(
  1713         text == rendered,
  1714         f"{label}: JSON is not sorted two-space ASCII form with one final LF",
  1715     )
  1716     return value
  1717 
  1718 
  1719 def read_candidate_bytes(relative: str) -> bytes:
  1720     _mode, raw = stable_regular_file(relative)
  1721     return raw
  1722

  1724 def git_blob_at(commit: str, relative: str) -> bytes:
  1725     process = git_process("show", f"{commit}:{relative}")
  1726     return process.stdout

  1729 def sanitize_rust(source: str) -> str:
  1730     output = list(source)
  1731     length = len(source)
  1732     cursor = 0
  1733 
  1734     def blank(start: int, end: int) -> None:
  1735         for index in range(start, end):
  1736             if output[index] != "\n":
  1737                 output[index] = " "
  1738 
  1739     while cursor < length:
  1740         if source.startswith("//", cursor):
  1741             end = source.find("\n", cursor + 2)
  1742             end = length if end < 0 else end
  1743             blank(cursor, end)
  1744             cursor = end
  1745             continue
  1746         if source.startswith("/*", cursor):
  1747             start = cursor
  1748             depth = 1
  1749             cursor += 2
  1750             while cursor < length and depth:
  1751                 if source.startswith("/*", cursor):
  1752                     depth += 1
  1753                     cursor += 2
  1754                 elif source.startswith("*/", cursor):
  1755                     depth -= 1
  1756                     cursor += 2
  1757                 else:
  1758                     cursor += 1
  1759             require(depth == 0, "Rust source contains an unterminated block comment")
  1760             blank(start, cursor)
  1761             continue
  1762         raw_match = re.match(r'(?:br|r)(#{0,255})"', source[cursor:])
  1763         if raw_match is not None:
  1764             start = cursor
  1765             hashes = raw_match.group(1)
  1766             cursor += raw_match.end()
  1767             terminator = '"' + hashes
  1768             end = source.find(terminator, cursor)
  1769             require(end >= 0, "Rust source contains an unterminated raw string")
  1770             cursor = end + len(terminator)
  1771             blank(start, cursor)
  1772             continue
  1773         if source[cursor] == '"' or source.startswith('b"', cursor):
  1774             start = cursor
  1775             if source[cursor] == "b":
  1776                 cursor += 1
  1777             cursor += 1
  1778             escaped = False
  1779             while cursor < length:
  1780                 character = source[cursor]
  1781                 cursor += 1
  1782                 if escaped:
  1783                     escaped = False
  1784                 elif character == "\\":
  1785                     escaped = True
  1786                 elif character == '"':
  1787                     break
  1788             else:
  1789                 raise PhaseIsolationError("Rust source contains an unterminated string")
  1790             blank(start, cursor)
  1791             continue
  1792         cursor += 1
  1793     return "".join(output)
  1794 
  1795 
  1796 def validate_parallel_semantics() -> None:
  1797     relative = "crates/pid-core/tests/parallel_bit_identity.rs"
  1798     raw = read_candidate_bytes(relative)
  1799     try:
  1800         source = raw.decode("utf-8")
  1801     except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
  1802         raise PhaseIsolationError(f"{relative}: non-UTF-8 Rust source") from error
  1803     expected_gate = '#![cfg(feature = "experimental-pipelines")]'
  1804     require(
  1805         source.startswith(expected_gate + "\n\n"),
  1806         "parallel bit-identity test has a zero-test-capable crate gate",
  1807     )
  1808     require(
  1809         '#![cfg(all(feature = "experimental-pipelines", feature = "parallel"))]'
  1810         not in source,
  1811         "parallel bit-identity test restored the false-zero serial gate",
  1812     )
  1813     sanitized = sanitize_rust(source)
  1814     conditional_attributes = tuple(
  1815         re.findall(
  1816             r"#\s*(!?)\s*\[\s*(cfg(?:_attr)?|ignore)\b",
  1817             sanitized,
  1818         )
  1819     )
  1820     require(
  1821         conditional_attributes == (("!", "cfg"),),
  1822         "parallel bit-identity conditional/ignore attribute inventory changed",
  1823     )
  1824     require(
  1825         not re.search(r"\bcfg\s*!\s*\(", sanitized),
  1826         "parallel bit-identity target contains a runtime cfg! gate",
  1827     )
  1828     require(
  1829         not re.search(r"\breturn\b", sanitized),
  1830         "parallel bit-identity target contains an early-return bypass",
  1831     )
  1832 
  1833     observed_constants: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
  1834     for match in re.finditer(
  1835         r"(?m)^\s*const\s+([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)\s*:\s*u64\s*=\s*([0-9_]+)\s*;",
  1836         sanitized,
  1837     ):
  1838         observed_constants.setdefault(match.group(1), []).append(
  1839             int(match.group(2).replace("_", ""))
  1840         )
  1841     for name, expected in EXPECTED_PARALLEL_U64_CONSTANTS.items():
  1842         require(
  1843             observed_constants.get(name) == [expected],
  1844             f"parallel bit-identity constant {name} is not the unique KSG-only value",
  1845         )
  1846     require(
  1847         observed_constants.get("PID2_SYN_BITS") != [FORBIDDEN_PID2_SYN_BITS],
  1848         "later PID2 represented-sum synergy bits contaminated the KSG phase",
  1849     )
  1850 
  1851     tests = tuple(
  1852         sorted(
  1853             re.findall(
  1854                 r"(?m)^\s*#\s*\[\s*test\s*\]\s*\n\s*fn\s+"
  1855                 r"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*\(",
  1856                 sanitized,
  1857             )
  1858         )
  1859     )
  1860     require(
  1861         tests == EXPECTED_PARALLEL_TESTS,
  1862         "parallel bit-identity test inventory no longer proves 12 nonzero serial tests",
  1863     )
  1864 
  1865 
  1866 def validate_stats_firewall() -> None:
  1867     relative = "crates/pid-core/src/stats.rs"
  1868     try:
  1869         source = read_candidate_bytes(relative).decode("utf-8")
  1870     except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
  1871         raise PhaseIsolationError(f"{relative}: non-UTF-8 Rust source") from error
  1872     sanitized = sanitize_rust(source)
  1873     for token in (
  1874         "FINITE_SUM_LIMBS",
  1875         "exact_binary64_sum",
  1876         "round_finite_sum",
  1877     ):
  1878         require(
  1879             not re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(token)}\b", sanitized),
  1880             f"stats.rs contains forbidden later-wave exact-sum token {token}",
  1881         )

  1884 def validate_release_firewall() -> None:
  1885     relative = "release-scope-1.0.json"
  1886     raw = read_candidate_bytes(relative)
  1887     scope = canonical_json_from_bytes(raw, label=relative)
  1888     require(isinstance(scope, dict), "release scope root must be an object")
  1889     families = scope.get("families")
  1890     require(
  1891         isinstance(families, list) and len(families) == 35,
  1892         "release scope must retain exactly 35 family objects",
  1893     )
  1894     by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
  1895     revisions: list[str] = []
  1896     for index, family in enumerate(families):
  1897         require(isinstance(family, dict), f"release family {index} must be an object")
  1898         family_id = family.get("id")
  1899         revision = family.get("estimator_revision")
  1900         require(
  1901             isinstance(family_id, str)
  1902             and family_id
  1903             and family_id not in by_id
  1904             and isinstance(revision, str)
  1905             and revision,
  1906             f"release family {index} has invalid typed identity/revision",
  1907         )
  1908         by_id[family_id] = family
  1909         revisions.append(revision)
  1910     for family_id, expected in EXPECTED_RELEASE_REVISIONS.items():
  1911         require(family_id in by_id, f"release family {family_id!r} is missing")
  1912         require(
  1913             by_id[family_id]["estimator_revision"] == expected,
  1914             f"release family {family_id!r} is not at the KSG-only bridge revision",
  1915         )
  1916     for revision in revisions:
  1917         lower = revision.lower()
  1918         require(
  1919             revision not in FORBIDDEN_COMBINED_RELEASE_REVISIONS
  1920             and "represented-input" not in lower
  1921             and "represented_input" not in lower
  1922             and "exact-synergy-sum" not in lower,
  1923             f"release scope contains later combined revision {revision!r}",
  1924         )
  1925 
  1926     markdown = read_candidate_bytes("RELEASE_SCOPE_1_0.md")
  1927     try:
  1928         markdown_text = markdown.decode("utf-8")
  1929     except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
  1930         raise PhaseIsolationError("RELEASE_SCOPE_1_0.md is not UTF-8") from error
  1931     for forbidden in FORBIDDEN_COMBINED_RELEASE_REVISIONS:
  1932         require(
  1933             forbidden not in markdown_text,
  1934             "rendered release scope contains a later combined revision",
  1935         )
  1936     for expected in EXPECTED_RELEASE_REVISIONS.values():
  1937         require(
  1938             markdown_text.count(expected) == 1,
  1939             f"rendered release scope does not uniquely contain {expected!r}",
  1940         )
  1941
